input:
Earlier scenes:
(none)

This scene:
古代的时候，孟子和孟母住了在靠墓地的家。孩子才五岁就每天在墓地祭拜了。在那个城市，孟母从早到晚都找工作，可是找不到，害得孟母没有钱。难怪她跟孩子搬家，原来买不了房。他们搬了到别一个城市找工作。

The teacher's corrections on this scene (student words：her correction, her note):
- 古代的时候，孟子和孟母住了在靠墓地的家：在古代，better to briefly introduce “孟子” when this character first appears；住在靠近墓地的地方/墓地附近，delete了，在+Place
- 孩子才五岁就每天在墓地祭拜了：孟子，孩子is vague and unclear
- 难怪她跟孩子搬家，原来买不了房：wrong information, 搬家因为孟母觉得it is not good to imitate how to offer sacrifices
- 他们搬了到别一个城市找工作：搬到了，另外一个城市，“别（的）” is for “a different type”, and “all else except the spoken one”, whereas “另外“ is for “addition in quantity”, and “another, the other”

The system's feedback items:
1. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 古代的时候：在古代，this phrase redundantly combines a historical time noun with a second “time of” expression. [teacher rule: gudai_de_shihou_why]
2. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 住了在靠墓地的家：住在墓地旁边的家里，this is a continuing living situation, so it does not take completed `了`; the location follows `在`, and `家里` clearly marks the place of residence. [teacher rule: le_placement]
3. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 祭拜了：祭拜，this is a daily routine, so it uses the zero aspect form rather than completed `了`. [rule: aspect_le_completed]
4. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 跟孩子搬家：带着孩子搬家，this expression means that the mother takes her child with her when moving; `跟` means “with” but does not express that relationship as precisely here. [vocab list]
5. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 搬了到：搬到了，`了` follows the verb-plus-direction/result expression, not the verb before `到`. [teacher rule: le_placement]
6. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 别一个城市：另一个城市，`另一个` is the standard expression for one additional or different city; `别的` is used to distinguish others from the one already discussed. [teacher rule: bieren]
7. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): 孟子和孟母：有一个小男孩叫孟子，他和妈妈，this is the first mention of the main character, so introduce him as a child with his name before using the family title for his mother. [rule: character_introduction_first_mention]
8. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): 孩子：他，Mengzi was named in the immediately preceding sentence and no other male character competes with him, so a pronoun is the natural close re-occurrence form. [rule: ambiguous_reference]
9. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): 那个城市：他们住的城市，no city has been introduced before this point, so `那个` has no clear earlier referent; use a full noun phrase to identify the place. [rule: character_introduction_first_mention]
10. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): 害得孟母没有钱：害得她没有钱，Mengmu is already the subject of this sentence, so use a pronoun for the close re-occurrence rather than repeating her name. [rule: ambiguous_reference]

items.reason: 古代 already denotes a time period, so 古代的时候 is redundantly formed under the teacher's rule.
住了在 has both incorrect 了 placement and an inappropriate completed aspect for a continuing residence.
每天 describes a routine, so 祭拜 should not take perfective 了.
跟孩子搬家 is an acceptable way to say that she moved house with her child; 带着孩子 is only a stylistic alternative.
With the directional complement 到, 了 must follow 搬到 rather than precede 到.
别一个城市 is not appropriate here; 另一个城市 is a correct expression for another city.
孟子 needs an introductory first mention, but the proposed replacement ends with the incomplete subject 他和妈妈 when shown by itself.
孩子 is vague after the named character has just been introduced, whereas 他 clearly refers to 孟子.
那个城市 lacks an established city referent, while 他们住的城市 identifies it without assuming prior mention.
孟母 has just been the sentence subject, so the close re-reference should be 她 rather than repeating her name.
